scenes.line1: How does your site adapt to screens?
scenes.say: How does your site adapt to different screens? What makes a layout truly responsive?

scenes.label: Flexible
scenes.sub: Responsive design uses flexible grids, images, and CSS media queries.
scenes.say: Responsive design uses flexible grids, images, and CSS media queries to adapt layouts for any device.

rows.b: Write styles for mobile screens first
Add media queries for larger screens

scenes.say: Start with mobile styles, then use media queries to enhance for bigger screens. Always test your layout on multiple devices.
Here's a media query. When the screen is at least six hundred pixels wide, the container switches to row direction.

scenes.question: Should you start with desktop styles?
scenes.right: No, mobile-first ensures accessibility and device flexibility.
scenes.say: Should you start with desktop styles? No. Mobile-first ensures accessibility and flexibility for all devices.
